title: Capacity commitment bundles + instance family rollout playbook (EU/APAC)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Playbook to coordinate the launch of new Dedicated capacity offerings across EU and APAC: two instance families (c6d-style and m-family equivalents), new 12/24/36 month commitment bundles, and a migration path for existing reservations. Covers cross-functional readiness (billing, console, docs, sales enablement, partner marketplace, legal), targeted pilot customers, and rollback conditions.
background: Demand for predictable throughput in regulated regions has increased. We are adding two instance families optimized for low-latency (edge-similar configs) and high-throughput batch workloads, plus commitment bundles to improve predictability for enterprise buyers. Previous launches focused on single-region rollouts; this playbook captures lessons learned and standardizes coordination across multiple regions and billing models.
objectives: 1) Launch new instance families in eu-central-1 and ap-southeast-1 with GA console, API and reservation UI. 2) Offer 12/24/36 month commitment bundles with clear billing mapping and migration tool for existing reservation customers. 3) Enable sales and partner channels with playbooks and collateral. 4) Keep SLOs and cost reports accurate across new SKUs.
scope: In scope: console UI updates (reservation purchase flow), billing/pricing mapping, API/versioning changes, marketplace listing coordination, pilot customer migrations, release notes sequencing. Out of scope: on-prem package changes and non-dedicated hosted API features.
acceptance_criteria: - Console reservation flow supports new instance families and bundle durations. - Pricing table published and validated in billing test environment. - Migration tool tested with 3 pilot customers and rollback validated. - Release notes drafted and approved by docs and legal. - Sales enablement kit published in Drive and shared with channel partners.
success_metrics: - 90% of pilot migrations complete within SLA. - <5% billing reconciliation errors during first billing cycle. - 20% uptake of 24/36 month bundles among pilot prospects. - No critical incidents tied to SKU rollout for 30 days post-GA.
launch_timeline: 2026-02-18: Final SKU definitions and on-call paging owners confirmed
2026-03-10: Release notes and docs final review
2026-03-24: Marketing and partner enablement assets published
deliverables: Console reservation UI changes (PR + release notes)
Billing mapping matrix and test cases
Sales enablement slide deck and FAQ
launch_checklist: Confirm instance family performance profiles and costly-path benchmarks
Complete pricing approvals and legal signoff for EU data residency language
Billing sandbox validation: invoice generation & reconciliation
Update Console: product selector, duration picker, and terms copy
Publish release notes across Console, Docs, and Release Notes channel
Train frontline support and Sales (enablement session recorded)
Enable partner marketplace listing and verify provisioning flow
Schedule post-launch incident review with ENG and SRE
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Billing mapping errors cause incorrect invoices. Mitigation: run two full billing cycles in sandbox and run reconciliation jobs with finance before GA.
Risk: Migration tool fails for edge cases. Mitigation: sandbox dry-run with pilot customers and maintain manual fallback procedure.
Risk: Performance regressions on new instance family under specific workloads. Mitigation: extend load-testing matrix, add canary traffic and autoscaling guardrails.
Risk: Marketplace provisioning delays in APAC. Mitigation: coordinate early with marketplace ops and add buffer to timeline.
Risk: Compliance questions related to EU data handling. Mitigation: include Legal in signoff and prepare data flow diagrams for customers and auditors.
go_to_market: Publish customer-facing announcement on blog and in-console banner
Run webinar for pilot customers and top 50 prospects
Send targeted enablement to channel partners with SSO demo
Coordinate co-marketing with select partners in APAC
support_playbook: 2-hour turnaround SLA for priority ticketing in first 30 days
Escalation path: Support -> Engineering Triage -> SRE -> PM
Pre-approved crediting guidelines for billing disputes during migration
billing_migration_notes: Existing reservation customers will be offered an opt-in migration path with pro-rated credit. Finance to review AU/JP tax implications for APAC territories. Migration tool will create a pending invoice preview for customers to confirm before finalizing.
communication_plan: Internal: All-hands email to Sales/CS/Support day of GA
External: Customer announcement + targeted emails to customers with expiring reservations
Partners: Marketplace notice 10 days before GA
Legal: Send final terms update to list of enterprise legal contacts
post_launch_tasks: Collect and publish migration telemetry for the pilot cohort
Billing reconciliation report for first invoice cycle
Post-launch retrospective and update public docs with lessons learned
notes: This playbook assumes the runtime kernel selection changes for the new instance family do not require a major version bump. If ENG identifies a breaking change, adjust timeline by at least two sprints. Keep PM-17001 and PM-15842 in sync for partner commitments.
